burro wait · wait for a run to end, then print its summary

Usage: burro wait [id] [--timeout 60m]

  --timeout d    stop waiting after this long, the run goes on (default 60m)

Example
  burro wait r42 --timeout 30m

Exit codes  0 passed · 1 tests failed · 2 server problem or runner died
            3 still running, wait again · 4 bad flags or unknown run
